contract.fill: receipt -> first next-minute open, max 120s extra delay; no stale catch-up
contract.session: 01:00 flat, no new entry 01:00-08:45 or outside calendar session
contract.boundary: flat book at each window start; raw source state rebuilt from prior receipts; open ending legs marked only
contract.unknown_source: zero until first received event; no future backfill; strict later-window sensitivity included
contract.reverse: negative of original rule target; same entry/exit clock; original rule state kept separate
contract.variants: E 1..7, F 1..6; hold 1/1 or entry thresholds; original long/short/both; plain or Again lock+opposition veto; plus 13 individual books
contract.selection: train only: original gross failure >50%, >=20 closed legs, reverse expectancy >0; full exploratory >=30 legs
contract.validation_caveat: chronological diagnostic, not pristine holdout: existing rules and hypothesis may have been informed by this history
